entities.summary: Takao Iijima, better known by his art name Ay-O, is a Japanese avant-garde visual and performance artist who has been associated with Fluxus since its international beginnings in the 1960s. Ay-O was a authors & novelists from Tamatsukuri (b. 1931-05-05, Tamatsukuri). A moderately significant entity in the historical record. Relevant to cause-and-effect analysis.
